svg.title: /develop:fix · /develop:feature · /develop:refactor
svg.desc: /develop:fix · /develop:feature · /develop:refactor — shared execution architecture — solo spine, team branches, gates
svg.text: shared execution architecture — solo spine, team branches, gates
↺ dashed = same stage reused, see its home card
solo spine: one spawn at a time, no fan
bold = key name · italic = condition, bound or opt-out

g.text: fix: archaeology → outcome A / B / C
fix repro, feature demo: must fail

text.tspan: background when it may pass 10 min

g.text: never reported green on a fail

svg.text: TEAM BRANCHES (--TEAM) · EACH OPENS WITH THE TEAM_PROTOCOL.MD GUARD

text.tspan: no teammate resume, no new spawn

g.text: Gate T1: green on unmodified code
Gate T2: same tests still green
--accept-no-plan → no plan file, concise plan kept
fix outcome A → existing test reused
no suite beyond the regression test → sole check

svg.text: Diagram only — SKILL.md is normative; update both with any step/gate/fan-out change.
